_instructions: Only current app-field causality may make an entry functionally in scope. The five-surface envelope is structural.

multiSurfaceScope.sliceContract: affectedSurfaces and evidence determine actual scope

evidenceIndex.result: Derived support cannot expand field scope.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Governance rule; implementation still requires code evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: DSH owns operational truth and WLT owns financial truth; app-field is an official operating surface.
evidenceIndex.result: Field scope must respect domain ownership.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field agent, partner owner, control operator and client are the onboarding/publication actors; captain is excluded.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Product Truth is READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION, not runtime evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field activation/session is Identity-owned and Workforce-governed.
evidenceIndex.result: Identity/Workforce are in field trust scope.

evidenceIndex.claim: Field wallet/ledger/commissions/payout requests use DSH while WLT remains financial owner.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Capability state is DISCOVERY and needs runtime/finance evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: app-field is explicitly excluded from store-to-captain custody after readiness.
evidenceIndex.result: Captain handoff/COD is out of this package.
evidenceIndex.limitations: A future Product Truth could change this boundary.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current session/workforce/readiness/deep-link composition and blank readiness gap.
evidenceIndex.result: Substantial runtime exists; readiness unresolved state needs closure.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Static source is not device evidence.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current field offline operation schema and storage/retry semantics.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Backend replay behavior still requires runtime tests.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current work queue contains visits and escalations.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Controller/backend may expose additional state not rendered here.

evidenceIndex.result: Start/checklist/complete/verification exist with precise location problems.
Barcode text search exists; camera capture is unproven and proposal barcode is null.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Later file sections and backend rules require execution-time tracing.

evidenceIndex.result: Submission exists; post-submission field lifecycle needs proof.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Operator resolution routes require execution-time trace.

evidenceIndex.claim: Current app-field test script runs generic mobile runtime contract checker.
evidenceIndex.result: Declared test command is not sufficient field behavioral proof.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Other repository test commands may cover some paths.

evidenceIndex.claim: A field-specific test exists outside the package test script.
evidenceIndex.result: Test entrypoint coverage must be corrected.
evidenceIndex.limitations: One test is not full field coverage.

evidenceIndex.claim: Prior diagnosis contains useful historical findings.
evidenceIndex.limitations: Stale support artifact; not current truth.

evidenceIndex.result: May help find affected paths but cannot expand scope.

entries.name: app-field

entries.name: app-partner

entries.name: app-client
entries.summary: Only public store/catalog/product readback after field-related publication gates.

entries.name: app-captain

entries.name: hr
entries.summary: Field professional profile/readiness/assignment operator readback.

entries.name: operations
entries.summary: Field visits/readiness/escalation operational readback.

entries.name: partners
entries.summary: Partner onboarding evidence, review, activation and store state.

entries.name: catalogs
entries.summary: Review/readback of field-linked central catalog and proposals where exposed.

entries.name: support
entries.summary: Field escalation/support resolution and diagnostics readback.

entries.name: finance
entries.summary: Permission-scoped field representative wallet/ledger/commission/payout lookup only.

entries.name: administration
entries.summary: Generic administration is not a field-originated journey gate.

entries.name: analytics
entries.summary: Generic analytics is not required to execute or close field business mutations.

entries.name: dashboard
entries.summary: Generic dashboard is not a field-originated journey gate.

entries.name: login

entries.name: marketing

entries.name: platform
entries.summary: Generic platform administration is not a field-specific closure journey.

entries.name: Identity
entries.summary: Field actor activation/session/device trust only.

entries.name: Workforce
entries.summary: Field professional profile, assignment and readiness only.

entries.name: DSH
entries.summary: Operational truth for field onboarding, stores, visits, readiness, catalog, escalation and DSH finance facade.

entries.name: WLT

entries.name: Media
